strings.El listado no declara fecha ni versión:: The listing declares no date or version: each risk page says when it was published («Last Published»). The notice that NASA is not updating the site because of the lapse in federal funding, which the front page showed on 2026-10-20, is still in its HTML on 2026-10-23 inside a comment: it is no longer visible, and it carries no date.
strings.El título del riesgo nombra la vuelta a: The risk title names the return to gravity, and the NASA page puts back pain under «Gravity Fields».
strings.El dominio musculoesquelético registra e: The musculoskeletal domain records the back pain the crew member reports; there is no imaging of the spine or the disc. In the Roadmap the risk is inactive: the HSRB closed the concern.
strings.La página de NASA pone los trastornos co: The NASA page puts behavioral, cognitive and psychiatric disorders under «Isolation and Confinement».
strings.Es el riesgo que cita el dominio conduct: It is the risk the behavioral domain cites. Its evidence report names the Cognition battery («contains 10 subtests»), whose nine tests without a prior indicator entered on 2026-10-31 as descriptive, with their speed and accuracy; the tenth, the PVT, already had its own and the status reads them.
strings.La página de NASA pone en «Distance from: The NASA page puts under «Distance from Earth» that the crew has to be able to run analyses if someone falls ill during the mission.
strings.Cada dominio de EMMA dice qué parte de l: Each EMMA domain says which part of the ExMC medical conditions list (AMCL) it watches and which it does not; EMMA does not identify or treat any condition, and many on the list have no domain.
strings.La página de NASA pone los microorganism: The NASA page puts microorganisms that pass from one person to another under «Hostile/Closed Environments».
strings.El dominio inmune vigila la parte del hu: The immune domain watches the host side: markers, reactivation of latent viruses and symptoms. Air and surface microbiology is shown without being evaluated, and the virulence of microorganisms is not measured.
strings.La página de NASA no nombra el polvo; EM: The NASA page does not name dust; EMMA puts it under the hostile environment, as an exposure from the surroundings.
strings.EMMA no mide la exposición al polvo ni l: EMMA does not measure dust exposure or airborne particles: the cabin limits it evaluates are gases, pressure, temperature, noise and humidity.
strings.El título del riesgo nombra la operación: The risk title names operation independent of Earth, and the NASA page puts under «Distance from Earth» that the crew has to solve problems as a team.
strings.EMMA es una herramienta para trabajar si: EMMA is a tool for working without support from Earth, but it does not measure how the crew performs in operations: no domain watches this risk.
strings.La página de NASA pone la orientación es: The NASA page puts spatial orientation, coordination, balance and gait under «Gravity Fields».
strings.Desde el 2026-10-31, el dominio musculoe: Since 2026-10-31, the musculoskeletal domain records as descriptive two functional balance and gait tests from the Spaceflight Standard Measures protocol, the ones the evidence report describes after flight: the percentage of correct steps in tandem walk and the time to stable posture on standing up after lying down. They are signed and shown; the status does not read them, and EMMA has no sensorimotor domain. Vestibular function, posturography (its score is not written in what was read), eye-hand coordination and adaptation motion sickness are not measured.
strings.puntuación de equilibrio de la posturogr: balance score from computerized dynamic posturography (Sensory Organization Test, EquiTest)
strings.tiempo de sentarse-levantarse, tiempo de: sit-to-stand time, walk time and turn rate from the Standard Measures «walk-and-turn» test
strings.valoración del mareo por movimiento de 0: Standard Measures motion sickness rating from 0 to 20
strings.La página de NASA pone la pérdida de den: The NASA page puts the loss of mineral density in weight-bearing bone under «Gravity Fields».
It is the risk the bone domain cites.
strings.La página de NASA pone la caída de la fu: The NASA page puts the decline in cardiac function and orthostatic intolerance under «Gravity Fields».
strings.Es el riesgo que cita el dominio cardiov: It is the risk the cardiovascular domain cites.
strings.La página de NASA pone la alteración inm: The NASA page puts altered immunity and the reactivation of latent viruses under «Hostile/Closed Environments».
It is the risk the immune domain cites.
strings.La página de NASA no nombra las cargas d: The NASA page does not name dynamic loads; EMMA puts them under gravity fields because they occur at launch and landing, when gravity changes.
strings.EMMA no registra las aceleraciones de la: EMMA does not record launch, landing or impact accelerations on the crew member; the impact load the bone domain counts is that of exercise.
strings.La página de NASA pone en «Isolation and: The NASA page puts under «Isolation and Confinement» that communication and understanding among crew members are vital to the mission.
strings.Ningún dominio vigila este riesgo: ningú: No domain watches this risk: no evaluated indicator measures the team's cooperation, coordination or communication. Since 2026-10-31 EMMA records, as descriptive items the status does not read, the three cohesion statements from the Standard Measures end-of-day questionnaire (team-cohesion-cared, team-cohesion-task-focus, team-cohesion-shared-purpose: each crew member's agreement from 1 to 7 with each statement); recording them is not watching the risk, and the row stays out of scope.
strings.una medida de la cooperación, la coordin: a measure of the team's cooperation, coordination or communication: the report describes no instrument with its scoring, and refers to Standard Measures
strings.La página de NASA pone en «Distance from: The NASA page puts under «Distance from Earth» medications and packaging that withstand space.
strings.EMMA no lleva inventario de medicamentos: EMMA keeps no medication inventory and does not measure medication stability, and its countermeasures are not pharmacological.
strings.La página de NASA no nombra la actividad: The NASA page does not name extravehicular activity; EMMA puts it under the hostile environment, outside the spacecraft.
strings.EMMA enseña las salidas que declara la t: EMMA shows the EVAs the crew declares as context for an alert (temporal correlation, not cause), but it receives no suit telemetry and no domain watches this risk.
strings.La página de NASA no nombra la descompre: The NASA page does not name decompression; EMMA puts it under the hostile environment, because of the pressure changes of the suit and the habitat.
strings.La presión total de cabina es un límite: Total cabin pressure is a habitat limit, but EMMA does not track prebreathe or decompression symptoms, and no domain watches this risk.
strings.La página de NASA pone la pérdida de mas: The NASA page puts the loss of muscle mass under «Gravity Fields».
strings.El catálogo tiene el VO2 pico (dominio c: The catalog has peak VO2 (cardiovascular domain) and grip strength (musculoskeletal) and, since 2026-10-31, whole-body lean mass by DXA and the peak force of the isometric mid-thigh pull, the only strength measure Standard Measures also takes in flight; all four descriptive only. Regional muscle mass and isokinetic knee torque, whose protocol is not public, are not measured.
strings.par isocinético de la rodilla a 60°/s (p: isokinetic knee torque at 60°/s (AMMERD 6.1 protocol, not public)
strings.prensa de piernas (una repetición máxima: leg press (one-repetition maximum) from the functional fitness assessment
strings.masa magra de las piernas por DXA o volu: leg lean mass by DXA or muscle volume by MRI
strings.La página de NASA pone en «Distance from: The NASA page puts under «Distance from Earth» the food that has to be carried for the whole mission.
strings.Es el riesgo del dominio de nutrición, q: It is the risk of the nutrition domain, which cites it through the 2016 food system report. The Roadmap's evidence page today lists under this risk a 2024 food report and a nutrition book, which the domain does not cite.
strings.La página de NASA pone el ritmo circadia: The NASA page puts circadian rhythm and fatigue under «Isolation and Confinement».
strings.El dominio conductual vigila la duración: The behavioral domain watches sleep duration and efficiency, circadian misalignment and the PVT, and records NASA-TLX workload as descriptive; but it cites the behavioral health risk, not this one. The sleepiness and fatigue scales the report names do not come with their points or anchors in what was read, and remain pending.
strings.escala de somnolencia de Karolinska (KSS: Karolinska Sleepiness Scale (KSS): the report counts it among the measures of a Shuttle study and describes it as a single-item rating, without its points or anchors
strings.escala de fatiga de Samn-Perelli: el inf: Samn-Perelli fatigue scale: the report names it as the subjective fatigue rating of the aviation SAFE model, without its points or anchors
strings.La página de NASA pone el aumento del ri: The NASA page puts the increased cancer risk under «Space Radiation».
strings.Es el riesgo que cita el dominio de radi: It is the risk the radiation domain cites; EMMA tracks cumulative exposure and does not estimate cancer risk.
strings.La página de NASA no nombra la hipoxia;: The NASA page does not name hypoxia; EMMA puts it under the closed environment, because of the atmosphere of the spacecraft and the suit.
strings.La saturación de oxígeno es un indicador: Oxygen saturation is an indicator of the cardiovascular domain, and cabin oxygen and pressure are habitat limits; EMMA does not evaluate the reduced-pressure atmospheres or the extravehicular activities the risk starts from.
strings.La página de NASA pone el riesgo de cálc: The NASA page puts the risk of kidney stones from dehydration under «Gravity Fields».
strings.El dominio genitourinario registra la in: The genitourinary domain records fluid intake, 24-hour urine and its specific gravity, and renal function in blood. The 24-hour urine chemistry with which the evidence report assesses the risk is recorded and shown as descriptive: the status does not read it, and its figures are not compared with any threshold. Its ultrasound protocols do not look for stones. The domain cites this risk alongside its own, urinary retention.
strings.sobresaturación calculada de la brushita: calculated supersaturation of brushite (calcium phosphate) in 24-hour urine
strings.La página de NASA pone la presión sobre: The NASA page puts pressure on the eyes and vision problems under «Gravity Fields».
strings.Es el riesgo que cita el dominio neuro-o: It is the risk the neuro-ocular domain cites, through its 2017 evidence report; the risk page today links the 2022 version, which does not repeat the in-flight vision questionnaire from which EMMA reads the vision change.
